reading.action: Wake, gather some resources + wits, name the two iron bars (Burning Anger = the Ember-infused weapon; Cold Revenge = the cold-bitten bar, retrieved from the cistern), climb to the floor-3 stairhead, and cautiously scout what can be seen without attracting attention — ready to retreat at the first sign of trouble.
reading.result: STRONG SCOUT (margin 15) — reads floor 3 well AND stays UNNOTICED; withdraws clean. What he perceives from the stairhead (held-dark floor-3 truth revealed only to the cautious-peek slice; NO loop foreshadowing): a long, high, DRY gallery far larger than the cistern, vaulted dark overhead; a dim WARM reddish glow from the far end (not the cistern's cold dark); the floor strewn with the picked-clean LEAVINGS of climbers who came before and did not pass — old gear, bone, quiet evidence of failure (escalation: this floor has killed people); little to no cover, an open killing-floor; and at the far end, near the glow and the way up, a LARGE still shape — a guardian, bigger than the Ashling, not yet aware of him. His essence-sense reads a real essence-PRESENCE at the hall's end (the glow is not mere firelight). He does NOT engage, does NOT commit, draws back down a few steps ready to retreat. Floor 3 NOT entered/cleared (HUD floor/tier unchanged). NAMING: the two bars are now Burning Anger (weapon) and Cold Revenge. Floor 2 becomes his fallback CAMP (brazier, fuel, soaking river-stone left set up). COST: Stamina 52->50 (-2, climb + tense crouch). No HP/Focus, no skill/affinity. NO Tower reset.
